easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
